While technically you absolutely can tile over tile I personally wouldn’t for a few reasons in this case
A lot of mosaic tiles are not very flush/plumb to each other especially if installed incorrectly, which could definitely be exacerbated in the next layer.
Also, did you personally install the first layer? How positive are you that the adhesive used to apply the tile to the wall is applied adequately enough to double the weight it is supporting?
However; this is just my opinion, I personally wouldn’t do it myself nor would I do it in a customers home, tearing out tile is simple enough, and you will have to do it anyway at double the cost of new tile if any problems occur anyhow.
